# Everyone Who Writes Things Down

*Halloran has finally decided to ask for the notes. Half the harbour writes down what it sees, and nobody has put the pages together.*

|---|---|

## Objectives

1. Defeat 50 [Whipshade](../monsters/whipshade.md) in [The Crossways](../maps/crossways.md)
2. Talk to [Brisa](../npcs/brisa.md)
3. Talk to [Delphine](../npcs/delphine.md)
4. Talk to [Clemence](../npcs/clemence.md)
5. Talk to [Ottilie](../npcs/ottilie.md)
6. Bring 15 [Shade Lash](../items/shade_lash.md) (taken)

## Rewards

- 49,323 EXP
- 1,590 mesos
- +60 standing with [Halloran](../npcs/halloran.md)
- +25 standing with Bain Harbour
